title: Greek police increase security after protests against Israeli cruise ship
summary: Measures are being taken at the harbours of Patras and Katakolo, following demonstrations earlier this week Greek authorities have stepped up security in two harbours in an attempt to keep protesters away from a cruise liner carrying Israeli tourists on an 11-day tour around the Mediterranean. The measures taken at Patras and Katakolo on the Peloponnese followed demonstrations when the MS Crown Iris docked at Kalamata earlier this week. In July passengers on the same ship were prevented from disembarking and the ship was forced to divert to Cyprus after local people staged a protest on the Cycladic isle of Syros.
